title: ‘Queer Edward II’ Takes Us Behind the Scenes of Derek Jarman’s Film Shoot and a Political Backlash (Exclusive Venice Clip)
summary: Tilda Swinton and Sandy Powell are EPs on Theo Rollason's directorial feature debut, premiering at Venice: "I hope the film can function not simply as a snapshot of a historical moment, but as a reminder of what collective resistance can look like – and what role art has to play."
